purpose: Validate the v29 complete-front semantic signal on a document-disjoint, method-result-unseen cohort before opening any reserved test sample.
selection_rule: Starting after the 30 v29 clean-eligible selections, take the first clean-exact candidates in original frozen queue order while retaining distinct document IDs. No target candidate, attack output, or semantic endpoint result was used.
next_gate: Fresh-process clean replay, semantic clean-answer review, and clean-only complete-wrong-target generation. A sample without a valid target remains in the denominator as target-unavailable and is not replaced.
